title: Charli xcx Cancels Arizona Concert, Says ‘It Breaks Me’ to Miss It
summary: "I have been fighting sickness throughout this run of shows and have now completely lost my voice," she tells her fans ahead of Wednesday show.
contentText:
Charli xcx shared that she’s canceling her Wednesday show in Glendale, Arizona, after she “completely lost” her voice. The message, addressed to her “arizona angels,” came Tuesday night (Oct. 20) via Instagram Story .

“I have been fighting sickness throughout this run of shows and have now completely lost my voice,” she shared in part. “I put absolutely everything I have into my performances, both physically and emotionally, and it breaks me that i can’t be with you tomorrow.”

The concert would have been the second-to-last 2026 stop on Charli’s Music, Fashion, Film Tour , whose U.S. leg is set to wrap up Friday at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. The concerts kicked off last month in Philadelphia, and she has 2027 dates scheduled in Europe and South America.

Charli also shared that they tried to reschedule the show but couldn’t secure a new date, so refunds will be automatic for all Ticketmaster buyers and all others can get refunds at their point of purchase.

Find her full message below:

arizona angels

i am so so sorry to say we have to cancel tomorrow’s music fashion film show.

i have been fighting sickness throughout this run of shows and have now completely lost my voice. i put absolutely everything i have into my performances, both physically and emotionally, and it breaks me that i can’t be with you tomorrow.

my team worked hard to find a new date but ultimately were unable to. i’m so disappointed, but promise to return to AZ in the future < 3 refunds will be issued automatically for all who purchased via ticketmaster. for all others, refunds can be obtained at point of purchase.

again, i’m sorry to the angels who had made plans to be there tomorrow. i know how much time, planning, and care it takes to come to concerts and appreciate everyone’s support immensely.

i am now resting ahead of the final show in vegas this friday. i want to be back onstage and finish this tour together with you.

love you all x

charli
